title: Parts of Kumasi face power cuts from Monday to Wednesday, and Kumawu and Effiduase on Tuesday
text:
Parts of Kumasi face power cuts from Monday to Wednesday, and Kumawu and Effiduase on Tuesday | 3News Skip to content Search Watch live Business Agribusiness Banking Economy Energy Finance Real Estate Startups Telecom More Advertisement Energy Parts of Kumasi face power cuts from Monday to Wednesday, and Kumawu and Effiduase on Tuesday
 GRIDCo line works hit parts of Kaase for three days, while a separate cut on Tuesday covers Effiduase, Kumawu and nearby towns.
 By Araba Incoom Published 14 Nov 2026, 17:52 GMT 2 min read Share Share Comment Prefer 3News on Google Ask AI Listen to this article
 AI narration Playback position 0:00 2:42 10 10 Playback speed 1× Parts of Kaase, Boadi, Emina and other areas in and around Kumasi will be without power from 7:30am to 5pm on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday next week while the Ghana Grid Company (GRIDCo) upgrades a transmission line, the Electricity Company of Ghana (ECG) has said.
 A second, separate cut will hit Effiduase, Kumawu, Dadease and more than a dozen other communities in the Ashanti Region from 9am to 4pm on Tuesday, November 17, for ECG maintenance work.
 Both notices went up on ECG's official Facebook page on Saturday, and ECG apologised for the disruption in each.
 Monday 16 to Wednesday 18 November
 The three-day outage allows GRIDCo to keep working on the Anwomaso–Ridge Bulk Supply Point line.
 GRIDCo is swapping the existing 364MVA single-circuit line for a double-circuit one: two circuits of 488MVA each, 976MVA in all.
 The region has had months of unreliable supply. On November 5, ECG told the Energy Commission it had fitted 33kV panels to take GRIDCo's upgraded 145MVA transformer at the Ridge Bulk Supply Point.
 On October 29, GRIDCo and ECG said the 161kV Anwomaso–Ahodwo line upgrade in Kumasi was 70 per cent complete, with weekday outages along its route until November 29.
 ECG's notice does not say whether the Anwomaso–Ridge work is part of the Anwomaso–Ahodwo project.
 These are the areas ECG names for the cuts from 7:30am to 5pm each day, in alphabetical order:
 Abattoir
 Appiadu Kokoben
 Boadi
 Bomplex
 Coca-Cola
 Donyina
 Emina
 Fan Milk
 Georgia
 Guinness Ghana Ltd
 Kaase (parts)
 Surrounding areas
 Tuesday 17 November
 The maintenance cut runs from 9am to 4pm. ECG says the work is meant to improve service delivery.
 ECG is also doubling transformer capacity at its Offinso substation from 10MVA to 20MVA.
 The areas named for Tuesday, in alphabetical order:
 Abentenim
 Abotanso
 Akate Farms
 Aninangya
 Bodomase
 Bosore
 Dadease
 Duase
 Effiduase town
 Etia
 Kononogo Praso
 Kumawu
 Kumawu Township
 Nkyerepoaso
 Odoyefe
 Sekyere
 Wamase town
 Surrounding areas
 What to do
 Charge phones, power banks and rechargeable lamps the night before. If your water comes from an electric pump, fill containers early.
 Keep fridges and freezers shut during the cut, and unplug sensitive equipment so it is not hit when power returns.
 Neither notice gives a phone number. ECG posts its outage notices on its official Facebook page and its website .
